text.description_html:
Fusion PH-G1-ORB, Rock Ridge Arched Toilet Tissue Holder

This toilet tissue holder is a great addition to traditional homes. It comes in an oil rubbed bronze finish. No matter how big your roll is, the Sandcast Brass Scalloped Toilet Paper Holder can hold it. It is reversible to hang in either direction.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-G1 Rock Ridge Towel Bar, Fusion RH-G1 Rock Ridge Robe Hook, and Fusion TR-G1 Rock Ridge Towel Ring

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Scalloped Mount Toilet Paper Holder:

  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze
  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Mount Width: 2-7/8"
  • Mount Length: 3-5/8"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
